new_events.actor: United States / Iran / Qatar-mediated UNGA diplomacy
new_events.summary: Reuters reported U.S. and Iranian negotiators were exploring a phased arrangement pairing reopening of the Strait of Hormuz with lifting the U.S. economic blockade. Multiple Iranian, regional and Western diplomatic sources described sequencing as the central obstacle. No agreement, accepted sequencing mechanism or implementation was established by this horizon.

Reuters reported the Saudi, Pakistani and Turkish military chiefs were to meet urgently under the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement to discuss support for Saudi Arabia after escalating Houthi attacks. This established planned crisis consultation, not yet a completed meeting, deployment or combat commitment.

existing_event_updates.summary: After the Saudi-led coalition said it had intercepted six Houthi ballistic missiles aimed at Taif and the Yanbu area, the Houthis separately claimed missile and drone attacks on a 'sensitive target' in Riyadh and Saudi Aramco facilities in Yanbu. Reuters reported no immediate Saudi confirmation of the Riyadh attack or damage/casualties at Taif or Yanbu.

source_discovery_additions.addition: Reuters multi-source reporting on a phased Hormuz/blockade sequencing framework.
Reuters reporting of an urgent Makkah-pact chiefs consultation before the meeting occurred.

prior_drawer_reconciliation: Update U.S.-Iran UNGA contacts from generic engagement/no breakthrough to a reported phased Hormuz-versus-blockade framework; no agreement or implementation.
Update Sep.24 Saudi-Houthi strike chronology with later Houthi Riyadh/Yanbu target claims while keeping BDA unconfirmed.
Open a planned Makkah-pact crisis-consultation state that can later be superseded by the completed Sep.25 chiefs meeting.
